task_name: Visit Neighbor Daniel's City and Buy Materials from Trade Depot

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When Neighbor Daniel invites you to visit his city or daily when you want to buy discounted materials from his Trade Depot.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Daniel's Trade Depot sells discounted raw and crafted materials every day, saving factory/shop production time and accelerating early residential upgrades.
preconditions: Sufficient Simoleons (87 Simoleons total) and free City Storage space
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Locate the Trade Depot with the floating blue crate icon in Daniel's City.

steps.who: green 'Show me' button on Daniel's prompt
steps.briefing: open the Friends bar at the bottom-left.

steps.who: Trade Depot building with floating blue crate icon
steps.briefing: pan across Daniel's City to locate his Trade Depot near the Eiffel Tower.

steps.who: Metal crate (1x for 7 Simoleons) and Nails crate (1x for 80 Simoleons)
blue Home icon in the top-left corner
